description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PurgeServiceTest' that verifies the functionality of the 'PurgeService' class within the OrangeHRM project. The test class includes methods for testing data purging operations, strategy selection, and exception handling related to employee and candidate data management in the context of GDPR compliance or data cleansing scenarios. It uses mock objects, fixtures, and assertions to validate correct behavior and data integrity after purge operations.

classes.name: PurgeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PurgeService class responsible for purging data in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on employee and candidate data cleanup, strategy application, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating instances of PurgeService and loading fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePurgeDao
methods.description: Verifies that getPurgeDao returns an instance of PurgeDao.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Checks that getPurgeableEntities returns the correct list of entity names for a given purge strategy.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Tests that getPurgeStrategy returns an instance of ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy with correct match and parameter values.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy2
methods.description: Tests that getPurgeStrategy returns an instance of DestroyPurgeStrategy with correct match values.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs full purging of employee data and asserts that personal info, attachments, related entities, and logs are correctly purged or reset.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Checks handling of TransactionException during employee data purge, ensuring exceptions are correctly thrown.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy1
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy where candidates have not consented to keep data.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy2
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data where candidates have given consent to keep data.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy3
methods.description: Tests the case where no candidates have applied for the vacancy.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy4
methods.description: Tests that candidates who have not consented are removed, and others are preserved.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy5
methods.description: Tests the purging process when a candidate has started an interview.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Checks exception handling during candidate data purge.
